name: Gearhart Golf Links
architects: Front nine 1892, back nine 1913; links restoration 2013-15 (Wikipedia; unverified)

world.note: provisional: OSM boundary bbox (572 x 1,364 m) + 120 m each side, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred (about 220 m of scenery on every side)

scorecard_source: Club scorecard PDF (Golf ScoreCards Inc., 03/2020, 'Version 1'), GitHub release gearhart-data, supplied by the developer 2026-10-20. Every row adds up to its printed Out/In/Total. 'The Stones' is stored as Stones. The card prints no rating or slope: men's ratings from GolfPass (golfpass.com/travel-advisor/courses/51-gearhart-golf-links/scorecard-and-layout, retrieved 2026-10-20; unverified). GolfPass also lists a Craic set (5,896) that is not on the card, and its White row differs from the card only on hole 7 (273 against the card's 328; GolfPass's White holes add to 5,686). Stones, Black and Green agree hole by hole. Full card with the ladies' handicap row in scorecard_full.csv
notes: Standing defaults (COURSE_BUILD.md 4.1): Black tees only, all water red (Neacoxie Creek, w422896233, by the 6th and 8th tees: red_water_osm), OB = the OSM boundary, wind 3-14 mph (open coast), theme pnw. DTM/CHM, attribution for DOGAMI and the OSIP photo, and the intake answers (hole numbering 14-16, roads and parking lots, lidar age) are pending.
